app_info.subtitle: Play turn-based games
app_info.description: Turnplay Arena lets users play Chess, Go, Tic-Tac-Toe, Connect Four, Reversi, Mini 8-Ball, and Court Duel at Easy, Medium, or Hard difficulty, continue Go positions from board images or stone lists, and resume, reset, or end game sessions on an interactive board.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates and persists a new private game session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only writes to the app's private game store and does not change public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new game session without deleting or overwriting existing game progress.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates and persists a new private Go session from the supplied stone coordinates.
justifications.open_world_justification: Keeps the transcribed position in the app's private game store and does not change public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a separate review-pending game and does not erase an existing game.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes a pending imported Go session to confirmed and advances its state version.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only updates the app's private game session and does not change public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Accepts the reviewed starting position without deleting move history or another game.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the authoritative game snapshot without modifying the session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the requested existing game session from the app's bounded private game store; it does not fetch arbitrary external resources or access third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change game progress.

justifications.read_only_justification: Appends one legal, version-checked move to the selected private game session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only updates the app's private game store and does not change public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Advances the game by one bounded move without deleting sessions or external data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes an active private game to a finished state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only updates the app's private game record and does not change public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Irreversibly freezes the selected game after explicit confirmation and matching version checks.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replaces the selected private game's progress with its initial position.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only updates the app's private game record and does not change public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Erases the selected game's move history after explicit confirmation and matching version checks.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the authoritative game snapshot and widget template without changing game state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the requested existing game session from the app's bounded private game store and returns the app's fixed widget template; it does not fetch arbitrary external resources or access third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only displays existing game data and does not erase or overwrite progress.

test_cases.description: Create a new Hard 9x9 Go game with the player assigned Black.
test_cases.user_prompt: Start a Hard 9x9 Go game. I will play Black.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a new Go session with difficulty hard, playerColor black, boardSize 9, resetEpoch 0, stateVersion 0, and an authoritative list of legal moves; the interactive board renders from the same gameId.

test_cases.description: Import a reproducible Go position from an explicit stone list for user review.
test_cases.user_prompt: Continue this 9x9 Go position: Black stones at D4 and F4, White stones at E4 and E5. I am White, Black moves next, and use Medium difficulty.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the exact Go position with playerColor white, turn black, importReview pending, no legal moves before confirmation, and an IMPORT_CONFIRMED receipt.

test_cases.description: Create Hard Tic-Tac-Toe with the player as White, then apply the assistant's exact B2 move using the returned identifiers.
test_cases.user_prompt: Start Hard Tic-Tac-Toe with me as White. When it is your turn, play B2 using the game ID, reset epoch, and version returned by the new game.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the requested fixture, the interactive board renders from the same gameId, then appends B2 exactly once as the assistant move, returns stateVersion 1 with the updated board, and includes a matching MOVE_CONFIRMED receipt.

test_cases.description: Create Medium Chess as White, apply e2e4, then reset it with explicit confirmation and the returned identifiers.
test_cases.user_prompt: Start Medium Chess with me as White, play my e2e4 move, then reset that game now while keeping the same color and difficulty.
test_cases.expected_output: The interactive board renders from the same gameId, then returns the same game ID, kind, player color, and difficulty with an empty move history, stateVersion 0, resetEpoch incremented by one, and a matching RESET_CONFIRMED receipt.

test_cases.description: Create Connect Four, then end that same active game after explicit confirmation using its returned identifiers.
test_cases.user_prompt: Start a Medium Connect Four game with me as Black, then yes, end that newly created game now.
test_cases.expected_output: The interactive board renders from the same gameId, preserves the board and move history, changes status to finished with finishReason ended, advances the state version once, and includes a matching END_CONFIRMED receipt.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the game app for live professional sports information.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What was the Lakers score last night?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because Court Duel is a fictional game and does not provide live sports scores.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not start a game for a general strategy explanation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Explain why the Sicilian Defense is popular without starting a game.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the user requested an explanation rather than an interactive game session.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Mini 8-Ball for venue search or reservations.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book me a table at a nearby pool hall.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it simulates Mini 8-Ball and does not search venues or make bookings.
